faq.q: What is a titanium brake pad retaining pin?
faq.a: A titanium brake pad retaining pin is a precision-machined brake pad hardware component used in brake pad retention spring pin for disc caliper. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What makes titanium brake pad retaining pin different from steel?
faq.a: Titanium titanium brake pad retaining pin weighs 45% less than steel equivalents while providing better fatigue resistance under cyclic braking loads. Lower thermal conductivity prevents brake fluid heat soak. Thread rolling (not cutting) ensures grain flow continuity for shear strength.

faq.q: How is titanium brake pad retaining pin manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Brake Pad Retaining Pin is manufactured using Hot forging. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium brake pad retaining pin?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
